The '''4 October 2025 New York City meetup''' was held at Squarrel Cafe.<ref name="cafe">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1366491247954497677/1423818116986830980 mgutman3, Star Wars CCG Discord #nyc-fall-2025, 3 October 2025].</ref> mgutman3 had set the date as 4 October 2025.<ref name="date">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1366491247954497677/1407398402207252611 mgutman3, Star Wars CCG Discord #nyc-fall-2025, 19 August 2025].</ref> The format was [[Premiere - Death Star II]].<ref name="fmt">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1366491247954497677/1413140597371568238 mgutman3, Star Wars CCG Discord #nyc-fall-2025, 4 September 2025].</ref> mgutman3 said four people were confirmed.<ref name="four">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1366491247954497677/1423818311539495032 mgutman3, Star Wars CCG Discord #nyc-fall-2025, 3 October 2025].</ref> mgutman3 said the group did not keep track of who won.<ref name="won">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1366491247954497677/1455321960593756255 mgutman3, Star Wars CCG Discord #nyc-fall-2025, 29 December 2025].</ref>
